drafts.to: You Yangs Gas & Welding Pty Ltd <accounts@youyangsgas.example>
drafts.subject: Invoice YYG08477 / PO 4500012108 - quantity billed exceeds quantity received
drafts.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice YYG08477 dated 2 September 2026 against our purchase order 4500012108 (your docket DD134022).

On line 1, Nitrogen, G-size cylinder refill, the invoice bills 12 ea. Our goods receipts show only 10 ea received, and none of these have previously been invoiced. This leaves a shortfall of 2 ea, which is $129.00 ex GST.

Could you please issue a credit note for the 2 ea shortfall, quoting invoice number YYG08477, so we can match it against the invoice? If you believe all 12 ea were delivered, please send us proof of delivery for the remaining 2 ea and we will review it promptly.

Once the credit note is received we will arrange payment for the 10 ea received in line with the 30-day terms.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
